response.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT transref, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_cnt FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY transref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_cnt) AS overall_avg FROM per), kept AS (SELECT p.transref, p.avg_cnt, o.overall_avg FROM per p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_cnt > o.overall_avg), kept_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_cnt) AS kavg FROM kept), res AS (SELECT k.transref, k.avg_cnt AS avg_anlycount, k.avg_cnt - k.overall_avg AS diff_above_overall, k.avg_cnt - ka.kavg AS diff_above_kept_avg FROM kept k CROSS JOIN kept_avg ka), ranked AS (SELECT res.*, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY diff_above_kept_avg DESC NULLS LAST) AS rnk FROM res) SELECT transref, avg_anlycount, diff_above_overall, diff_above_kept_avg FROM ranked WHERE rnk <= 10 ORDER BY diff_above_kept_avg DESC NULLS LAST
